_comment: Subsumption taxonomy for PBJT Jasa Kesenian dan Hiburan. 'parent' = immediate broader category. Leaf nodes are the concrete taxable services a Perda can name. Statutory nodes come from UU 1/2022 Pasal 55(1); local nodes are subdivisions introduced by a Perda and are the reason equality matching fails.

karaoke_keluarga.label: karaoke keluarga
karaoke_keluarga.origin: Perda Surabaya 7/2023 Pasal 27(2) - local subdivision, no statutory counterpart

karaoke_dewasa.label: karaoke dewasa
karaoke_dewasa.origin: Perda Surabaya 7/2023 Pasal 27(3) - local subdivision, no statutory counterpart

listrik_industri_sumber_lain.label: konsumsi tenaga listrik dari sumber lain oleh industri/pertambangan migas

listrik_dihasilkan_sendiri.label: konsumsi tenaga listrik yang dihasilkan sendiri

dan_sejenisnya.label: dan sejenisnya
dan_sejenisnya.reason: Unbounded extension of an enumerated list. Its denotation cannot be fixed without interpretation, so subsumption against the statutory lists is undecidable from text alone.
